items.detail: The existing feed preview reached all nine feeds and found 93 candidate notes and 16 signals. Eight original pages went through the local article review and prop parsers, yielding 19 analytic selections and five curated prop candidates for review. Direct source-table review added four Gary Pearson props to the 21 already checked.

Friday review recorded 21 attributable picks from BettingPros 1147–1149. Saturday review added timestamped calls from MafiaBets, The Redzone Report, the VSiN crossover’s closing NFL best-bets segment, and Friday’s queued Lock & Cash show. The approved late addendum contributes 28 additional source records before report deduplication. Contest cards, winner forecasts, first-half calls and team totals are labeled in Experts. A ladder-only discussion can appear in Props Lab as source evidence.
Found the late-week video and article listings. Video titles and show-level summaries were treated as leads. The Koerner publication reviewed in the archive concerns concluded Colts–Texans.

The existing Grok/video parser reproduced four Week 11 Sal Vetri legs from a single public slip. The Saturday review processed the Lock & Cash video from the media queue against the publisher’s YouTube episode. The separate Cody Brown image remains pending.
The official Friday tally was 16 of 37. This targeted public review did not re-audit all 37 or update the official tally.
